finalText: That rule is already in place — `route()` checks `state.lastSeen[event.key]` and drops (`return []`) if the current event is within 5 minutes of the last one seen for that key, before any priority/quiet-hours logic runs (`src/router.js:20-25`). `verify.js` covers it explicitly (the `dup`/`crit` probes) and passes, including the case where a repeat drops even a critical page. No change needed.
